verdict.rationale: Bolt.new's docs describe one-click hosting: 'Deploy to production from chat' and publishing lets you choose public/private visibility and attach a custom domain (bought or your own), giving a founder a straightforward path to a live URL. However, one hands-on community report describes a deployment leaving 'ghost files' and broken payment functionality after switching hosts, showing the process isn't always frictionless in practice. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the one-step publish flow succeeding cleanly, and resolution of the reported deployment reliability issue.
